title: Summarize the excerpt from 'dmoi3-tablet' (chunk 68.2) about mathematics: For example, a standard deck of 52 cards contains 26 red cards and 12 face cards. However, the number of ways to select
prompt: Summarize the excerpt from 'dmoi3-tablet' (chunk 68.2) about mathematics: For example, a standard deck of 52 cards contains 26 red cards and 12 face cards. However, the number of ways to select
true_answer: For example, a standard deck of 52 cards contains 26 red cards and 12 face cards. However, the number of ways to select a card which is either red or a face card is not 26 + 12 | 38 . This is because there are 6 cards which are both red and face cards. Example 1.1.1 How many two letter “words” start with either A or B? (A word is just a string of letters; it doesn’t have to be English, or even pronounceable.) Solution . First, how many two letter words start with A? We just need to select the second letter, which can be accomplished in 26 ways. So there are 26 words starting with A.
